name: baton
description: Baton marketplace: the conductor and refuter orchestrators with their shared team worker pack, and domain skills (Bevy, Rust, TypeScript, Vue3, Blender).

plugins.name: team
plugins.description: Team worker pack: 5 subagents (scout, architect, developer, tester, expert) shared by the baton:conductor and baton:refuter orchestrators; the conductor dispatches all but expert. The orchestrators, the context7 MCP server and the git-diff and okf-memory skills come from the baton dependency. Subagents work through the job-file protocol in the dispatching orchestrator's .claude/conductor/jobs/<job-id>/ or .claude/refuter/jobs/<job-id>/; the orchestrator is the only agent that talks to you and keeps the project's .claude/agent-memory/ vault. Run /baton:setup to enable the Task tools (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS) in the project's .claude/settings.json.

plugins.name: baton
plugins.description: Shared core and orchestrators: the baton:conductor and baton:refuter orchestrator agents, whose workers live in the team plugin, context7 MCP server, Task-tools SessionStart hook + /baton:setup, CRLF-restoring PostToolUse hook, git-diff, okf-memory and okf-memory-migrate skills.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Starship-style powerline statusline for Claude Code: repo/branch with live git flags, model + context window usage, and plan usage (5h session / weekly / Fable) with reset countdowns. Run /statusline:setup to wire it into settings.json.

plugins.name: bevy

plugins.name: blender
plugins.description: Blender-to-Bevy workflow conventions using bevy_skein 0.6.0. Apply when writing code that integrates with Blender or uses bevy_skein.

plugins.name: rust
plugins.description: Rust coding standards and conventions. Apply when writing or reviewing Rust files.

plugins.name: typescript
